notes.claim: A move that squashes a plane onto a line has no inverse, because a line cannot be unsquished into a plane.
A matrix is invertible if its determinant is not zero.
A system AX = B is solved by multiplying both sides by the inverse of A.
In mesh analysis, the loop currents are found with the inverse of the resistance matrix.
